I have combo pieces (Thassa's Oracle, Undercity Informer), fast mana (Lotus Petal, Simian Spirit Guide, Cabal Ritual), and disruption (Thoughtseize, Unmask). However, without a land, casting both Undercity Informer and Thassa's Oracle, and activating the Informer, on turn 1 is difficult given the color requirements. I have two disruption spells (Thoughtseize and Unmask). Unmask can be free but requires pitching a black card, which is a valuable resource. I'm going to put Unmask on the bottom, as Thoughtseize is generally a more surgical and reliable piece of early disruption.
